title: DTEP Encrypted Audit Record
description: Full encrypted JSON audit record (Artifact A). Held in Taler Exchange custody. Contains original subject identifiers in DD-18 scrubbed form. Accessible only on Audit Request for a specific M0 element.

id.description: Unique audit record identifier. Matches the id in the corresponding DTEPPublicRecord.

m0_reference.description: Taler coin commitment from M0 of the corresponding DTEPPublicRecord. Links Artifact A to the public record.

en16931_scrubbed.description: Full EN 16931 invoice object with forgettable fields replaced by DD-18 salted hashes. Structure mirrors EN 16931 semantic model.

invoice_number.description: EN 16931 BT-1. Invoice identifier. Retained as-is — not a forgettable field.

issue_date.description: EN 16931 BT-2. Invoice issue date. Retained as-is.

seller.description: Seller information. Subject identifiers replaced by DD-18 hashes.

name.description: EN 16931 BT-27. SHA512(salt || seller_name). Forgettable field.

vat_id.description: EN 16931 BT-29. SHA512(salt || seller_vat_id). Forgettable field.

address.description: EN 16931 BT-35. SHA512(salt || seller_address). Forgettable field.

iban.description: EN 16931 BT-34. SHA512(salt || seller_iban). Forgettable field.

nace_code.description: NACE Rev. 2 code. Retained as-is — maps to M3.

buyer.description: Buyer information. Subject identifiers replaced by DD-18 hashes.

name.description: EN 16931 BT-44. SHA512(salt || buyer_name). Forgettable field.

vat_id.description: EN 16931 BT-46. SHA512(salt || buyer_vat_id). Forgettable field.

address.description: EN 16931 BT-50. SHA512(salt || buyer_address). Forgettable field.

nace_code.description: NACE Rev. 2 code. Retained as-is — maps to M4.

cpv_code.description: CPV code for this line. Maps to M2.

unit_price.description: Unit price in EUR. Retained as-is.

line_total.description: Line total in EUR. Retained as-is.

tax_exclusive_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-109. Maps to M5. Retained as-is.

vat_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-110. VAT amount. Retained as-is.

tax_inclusive_amount.description: EN 16931 BT-112. Total with VAT. Retained as-is.

forgettable_fields.description: DD-18 metadata for all scrubbed fields.

salt_derivation.description: HKDF parameters used for salt derivation from M0 coin commitment.

m0_input.description: M0 coin commitment used as HKDF input key material.

scrubbed_fields.description: List of all scrubbed fields with their EN 16931 element reference.

payment_status.description: Taler payment status. Updated by Exchange on settlement.

settled_amount.description: Amount settled in EUR. Decimal string with two decimal places.

signing_timestamp.description: Taler Exchange signing timestamp. May differ from M1 issuance_bucket in batch/offline scenarios.

signing_key_id.description: Exchange signing key identifier at time of signing. For long-term verification archive.

lifecycle_reference.description: M0 reference of the original invoice for cancellation, correction, or credit note events.
